name: Douglas McGregor Theory X and Theory Y
excerpt: Douglas McGregor's Theory X and Theory Y describe two contrasting views of workforce motivation.
notes: Douglas McGregor's Theory X and Theory Y present two different views of individuals at work: Theory X assumes people inherently dislike work and must be coerced, while Theory Y assumes people are self-motivated and enjoy work.
context_summary:
- Theory X assumes people dislike work.
- Theory Y assumes people are self-motivated.
- Presents contrasting views of workforce motivation.
